what: Conventions worth knowing before editing R/
title: arcgisviz
text: S7 classes: Foo := new_class(properties = list(...)) - name string first arg (breaks :=’s inference, silently binds parent instead errors). s7x:: always fully-qualified package code. Optional properties: NA already satisfies s7x::class_string/ class_double/class_boolean/Enum (allow_na = TRUE) - wrapping needed, including property simply omitted constructor call (verified tests/testthat/test-type-defaults.R; used false broke omission round s7x fixes new_enum()/property_scalar()/property_range()/property_union() default-value handling). optional object-typed properties need s7x::property_union(Type, NULL, default = NULL) - literal NULL really respected omission now (property_union() used conflate “default arg supplied” “default = NULL supplied explicitly” deep-default Type instead; fixed). Color (R/color.R) r/g/b/(four class_double), raw [r,g,b,] tuple spec uses - deliberate exception, keep . DESCRIPTION’s Collate: field load-bearing - R/ files real cross-file dependencies. Add new files dependency order load_all() breaks “object found”. writing/editing S7 class, diff property names relevant @arcgis/charts-components .d.ts interface hand (see “Source truth” ) - data-raw/spec-type-registry.json stale, don’t diff anymore. roxygen2 doesn’t recognize := assignment operator, bare #' @export Foo := new_class(...) silently dropped - NAMESPACE entry, Rd file, error. Every :=-defined class needs explicit #' @name Foo (least one-line title) alongside @export never gets exported. Run just document twice adding new cross-references doc blocks ([Foo()] links) - first devtools::document() pass can report stale “resolve link” warning topic documented run; clears second pass new Rd file disk. Two functions sharing one Rd via @rdname share pkgdown topic , _pkgdown.yml must list exactly one check_pkgdown() reports double-listed. Deleting exported function also needs man/*.Rd removed hand - document() won’t, R CMD check fails “listed exports, present namespace”.
